# Film Dissolve

**Blend › Blend Mode** · v1.0.0 · 24 frames at 30 fps (8–60)

An additive dissolve: both scenes add together, so the midpoint glows like a film dissolve.

[Preview video](https://github.com/GTKottman/remotion-transitions/releases/download/media/film-dissolve@1.0.0.mp4)

## Where it is used

- Warm, nostalgic scene changes
- Music videos
- Bright footage

## Use it

```tsx
import { linearTiming, TransitionSeries } from '@remotion/transitions';
import { toPresentation } from './src/core';
import filmDissolve from './transitions/02-blend/blend-mode/film-dissolve';

<TransitionSeries.Transition
  presentation={toPresentation(filmDissolve, { /* params */ })}
  timing={linearTiming({ durationInFrames: 24 })}
/>
```

Use `linearTiming`: the transition applies its own easing.
